🌍 Global Security Outlook – 01 Oct 2025

⸻

AFRICA
•🇪🇹 / 🇸🇩 Ethiopia / Sudan – Rising floods in Sudan spark debate over Ethiopia’s new dam’s role.
•🇲🇬 Madagascar – Security forces fire teargas at youth protesters defying government dissolution.
•🇳🇬 Nigeria – Boat accident on Niger River kills at least 26 passengers.

⸻

EAST ASIA & PACIFIC
•🇵🇭 Philippines – Powerful earthquake kills at least 69; search for survivors ongoing.
•🇹🇭 Thailand – Severe flooding from storm Bualoi devastates farmland and infrastructure.

⸻

EUROPE
•🇩🇰 Denmark – EU leaders meet under tight security in Copenhagen after drone disruptions.
•🇲🇩 Moldova – Pro-European party retains majority; Kremlin influence efforts persist.

⸻

MIDDLE EAST & NORTH AFRICA
•🇲🇦 Morocco – Violent clashes erupt after days of protests over health and education reforms.
•🇾🇪 Yemen – Houthis claim missile strike on Dutch-flagged cargo ship in Gulf of Aden, ship ablaze.

⸻

SOUTH & CENTRAL ASIA
•🇧🇩 Bangladesh – Two dengue deaths and nearly 500 hospitalizations recorded in one day.
•🇵🇰 Pakistan (POK) – Eight protesters killed in heavy firing during anti-government unrest in Kashmir.

⸻

WESTERN HEMISPHERE
•🇨🇴 Colombia – Government cancels IMF credit line; central bank keeps interest rate at 9.25%.
•🇭🇹 Haiti – UN Security Council approves major troop increase to confront gang violence.
•🇲🇽 Mexico – Army special forces deploy in Juarez amid cartel violence; classes canceled at top university after student killing; President Sheinbaum marks first year with 70% approval.

Please donate and keep rt. Praying for Cebu.

Today, i called down there to check on them and if the equipments are being utilized. All i can say is I am so glad that i fought for that training.
